title: 航空構造力学
subtitle: Mechanics of Aircraft Structure
keywords: Structural configuration 2.Torsion 3.Thin-walled section bar 4.Normal and shear stresses 5.Principal stresses
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) features of the aircraft structure (2) how to analyze the deformation and stress of bars with circular cross section and thin-walled cross section under torsional moment (3) how to analyze normal and shear stresses on an arbitrary cross section of slender bar under uniaxial tensile load (4) how to analyze principal stresses and principal shear stress
advice: On the basis of Industrial Mechanics and Mechanics of Materials, students will learn how to analyze the deformation and stress of lightweight structural members of aircraft, such as thin-walled cross section bars and thin flat plates. We will cover the following materials: (1) Features of the aircraft structure (2) Torsion of bars with circular cross section (3) Torsion of bars with thin-walled cross section (4) Normal and shear stresses on an arbitrary cross section of slender bar under uniaxial tensile load (5) Principal stresses and principal shear stress of thin flat plate under in-plane load Students should thoroughly review what they have learned in Industrial Mechanics and Mechanics of Materials before taking this course.
books: Required materials will be specified in the first lesson.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of industrial mechanics and mechanics of materials.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the features of aircraft structure
Be able to calculate torsional stiffness and shear stress of bars with circular cross sections
Be able to calculate torsional stiffness and shear stress of bars with thin-walled sections
Be able to calculate normal and shear stresses on an arbitrary cross section of slender bar under tension
Be able to calculate principal stresses and principal shear stress of thin flat plate under in-plane load

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Explain features of aircraft structure from the viewpoint of structural mechanics (2) Accurately calculate the torsional stiffness and the torsional stress of bars with circular cross section (3) Accurately calculate the torsional stiffness and the torsional stress of bars with thin-walled section (4) Accurately calculate normal and shear stresses on an arbitrary cross section of slender bar under uniaxial tensile load (5) Accurately calculate principal stresses and principal shear stress of thin flat plate under in-plane load
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain some of the structural members that constitute the wing and fuselage of an aircraft (2) Calculate the torsional stiffness of bars with circular cross section (3) Calculate the torsional stiffness of bars with thin-walled section (4) Calculate normal and shear stresses on an arbitrary cross section of slender bar under uniaxial tensile load (5) Explain the meaning of technical terms ‘principal stresses’ and ‘principal shear stress’
